tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rnam par bshad pa zab don rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza he badz+ra ye/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rnam par bshad pa zab don rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba bla ma dang dpal dges mdzad rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad bla chen snying po'i mtshan/ /bsod nams ye shes rtse mo mthar son dang / /dad sgrol grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i zhabs/ /lnga rig paṇa chen 'phags mchog la sogs rgyal/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba ltar/ /bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i sprul pa'i sku/ /sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' rin chen gyi/ /rnam thar gang la bsam kyang snying nas 'dud/ /gang gi rigs sras dbang po'i mtshan can dang / /sngags 'chang rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab grags pa'i mtshan/ /rigs kun khyab bdag mus pa chen po sogs/ /rang gi rigs kyi cod pan mchog rnams bsngags/ /rgyal ba kun dngos dga' ba bzhi yis rtsen/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag /dbu skra dmar ser gyen brdzes sku mdog gnag /bzhi yis lhag pa'i nyi shu'i spyan dang ldan/ /zla phyed mche gtsigs thod phreng du ma 'dzin/ /nang gi ma rung thugs ldan bde chen dngos/ /bdag med bdag po rdo rje 'dzin de la/ /btud nas de yi gsang sngags byi dor bgyi/ /'dir dpal brtag pa gnyis pa'i phyi ma'i lnga pa las/ rje btsun kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i sngags gsungs pa/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba chen po dag gis legs par bsgyur mod kyang / rjes 'jug gi gdul bya phal cher lha'i skad la bag chags chung zhing brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos ma mthong bas/ gsang sngags phyin ci log tu bris pa dang / klog pa dang / bsgyur ba mthong la/ de ltar byas pas ni/ rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i tshul las 'das par 'gyur te/ rgyud las kyang / sgra ring ba dang bzang ba dang /

/bzlas pa khri yi gsal ba dang / /zhes sogs kyis bram ze rig byed 'don pa ltar skad kyi gtang rigs klog par gsungs pa dang / yi ge lhag chad du gyur pas sngags kyi nus pa nyams par bshad de/ yi ge bral ba'i rig pa bzhin/ /zhes pa'i tshig las so/ /des na de dag la phan pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i sngags gtan la dbab pa la gnyis/ yid ches bskyed phyir 'khrul med rgyud kyi rgya dpe las ji ltar 'byung ba'i sngags dgod pa/ de nyid mkhas pa'i man ngag gis gsal bar brgyan te bod kyi skad du gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u lnga pa'i rgya dpe las/ be dā nā mā di mañtsai wa/ ar+dhenu bin+du bhu ṣi taṃ rig byed rnams kyi dang po nyid/ /zla phyed thig les rnam par brgyan/ /pash+tsa daṣ+ṭa na nā ye ti/ piṅga lor+dha ke sha warat+ma ne de nas zhal brgyad pa zhes pa dang / /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes/ tsa turbing+sha ti ne tra ya ta da nu/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dza ya/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i spyan ldan pa/ /de rjes phyag ni bcu drug pa/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzi mu ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne ka dhā ri ṇe/ char sprin nag pa lta bu'i sku/ /thod pa'i phreng ba du ma 'dzin/ a dh+yāt+m+ya krū ra tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhen+du daṃ ṣ+ṭi ṇe/ khong nas 'khrug pa'i thugs ldan pa/ /zla ba phyed pa'i mche ba can/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ bsad par gyis bsad par gyis/ gyis gyis/ sgrogs sgrogs/ tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ rigs rigs/ skoms skoms/ sap+ta sā ga rān/ ban+dha ban+dha/ nā gāṣ+ṭa kān/ rgya mtsho bdun pa rnams/ chings chings/ klu brgyad po rnams/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trūn/ zungs zungs/ dgra bo rnams/ ha hā hi hi hu hū he hai ho hau ham̐ ha:phaṭa swāhā khos gzhi tshugs/ zhes 'byung ngo / /'di ni ston pas sngags btu ba'i sgo nas sngags kyi tshig lhag chad spang pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa yin te/

rdo rje phreng ba dang dgongs pa lung ston pa'i rgyud la sogs pa du ma las sngags tshigs bcad kyi btu ba'i tshul 'di 'byung ba yin no/ /spyir sngags btu ba la/ lus dang yan lag gis btu ba/ bzlog ste btu ba/ spel te btu ba/ tshigs su bcad pas btu ba dang bzhi yod pa las/ 'di phyi ma'o/ /de yang / rig byed rnams kyi dang po nyid/ /zla phyed thig les rnam par brgyan/ /ces pas oṃ yig gsungs pa ste/ rig byed rnams kyi dang po zhes bya ba 'di la/ slob dpon sbyangs dka' zla ba'i zhal snga nas/ nges brjod kyi rig byed ni o snyan ngag ni u/ srid srung ni um̐/ mchod sbyin ni a ste yi ge bzhi po'i tshad du 'dren pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /zla ba phyed pa dang ni thig le ni/ rnam par bcad pa dang / rjes su nga ro ste/ rnam bcad las zla phyed dang / rjes su nga ro las thig ler 'gyur tshul dus 'khor las e bam̐ gzugs bsgrub kyi skabs su gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /dag ldan gyi dpe gcig las/ zla phyed dang thig le ni am̐ ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ oṃ mi 'grub ste/ gzhan du na/ o a wa'o zhes 'byung bas a wam̐ zhes par 'gyur bas dgongs pa min no/ /de nas aṣ+ṭa na nā ye ti/ zhes pa la sogs pa la/ spyir sdeb sbyor gyi tshigs bcad la/ yi ge bgrang ba bṛt+ta dang / phyi mo bgrang ba dz+wa ti zhes bya ba gnyis yod la/ gnyis ka la'ang rkang pa bzhir nges pa yod de/ daṇ+ṭi'i tshig rgyan las/ tshig bcad rkang bzhi de yang ni/ /bṛt+ta dzā ti zhes rnam gnyis/ /de yi spros pa mtha' dag ni/ /sdeb sbyor gzhung du nges par bstan/ /rig de snyan ngag rgya mtsho ni/ /zab mo brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru/ /zhes 'byung la/ de'i tshul rgyas par ston pa slob dpon shan+ti ba'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas dang / chos rje sa skya paṇ+ṭi ta'i sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po dang / phyi rol pa'i drang srong dmar ser dang /

rgyal ba'i lhas byas pa dag yin no/ /de lta bu'i bṛt+ta sdeb sbyor la yi ge drug pa nas nyi shu rtsa drug pa sogs kyi bar las/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa'i rgyud 'di yang sdeb sbyor rjes su bsngags pas gsungs pa yin pas brgyad pa rjes su bsngags pa'i sdeb sbyor la/ yi ge bcu drug ni rkang pa gnyis te/ de la shad gcig byed/ de nas yang yi ge bcu drug rdzogs nas tshigs bcad song tsam na shad gnyis byed pa rgya gar gyi dpe rnams kyi lugs yin/ des na 'dir rkang pa brgyad la yi ge drug cu rtsa bzhi 'byung dgos pa la/ sngags kyi ngo bo yi ge drug cu oṃ bsnan pa'i bzlas byas pa'i sngags la yi ge drug cu re gcig yod/ las med pas zhes rje btsun gsung ba ni rags pa tsam ste/ zhib par na/ rgyud kyi tshigs bcad kha skong gi yi ge dang bcas pa la yi ge drug cu rtsa drug 'byung ste/ de nas aṣ+ṭa na nā ye ti/ zhes par/ de nas kyi skad do/ /pash+tsad yi ge gnyis/ zhes pa'i skad dod i ti/ yi ge gnyis yin kyang / na nā ye ti zhes yi ge mgo ma la mtshams sbyar ba na yi ge gong ma'i srog dang gcig tu 'gyur ba yin pa phyis pas 'dor bya'i yi ge gcig tad a nu mtshams sbyar ba/ ta da nu/ de'i rjes la zhes pa yi ge gnyis te gsungs kyang ta yi ge gcig a nu gnyis mtshams sbyar ba na'ang / ta da nu zhes pa 'ong bas/ yi ge gsum du mngon sum gyis grub pa dang / oṃ ma gtogs aṣ+ṭa na nā ya nas/ daṃ ṣ+ṭa ṇe'i bar la drug cu tham pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na oṃ dang bcas pas/ daṃ ṣ+ṭa ṇe'i bar la bzla bya'i sngags tshan dang po ni yi ge drug cu rtsa gcig ste/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa na nā ya/ rkang pa dang po yi ge drug ring po gsum dang thung ba'ang gsum/ piṅga lor+dhā ke sha warat+ma ne/ rkang pa gnyis pa yi ge dgu/ /thung ba ro yin ring ba me/ tsa turbing+sha ti ne tra ya/ rkang pa gsum pa yi ge brgyad/

/thung ba dus dang ring ba mig ṣo ṭa sha bhu dz+wa ya/ rkang pa bzhi pa yi ge drug ring ba lag pa thung ba mtsho/ kṛṣ+ṇa jī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ rkang pa lnga pa yi ge brgyad/ /thung ba 'byung ba ring po me/ ka pā la mā lā ne ka dhā ri ṇe/ rkang pa drug pa yi ge phyogs/ /thung ngu rig byed ring ba dus/ /a r+dhat+m+ya krū+u ra tsit+ta ya/ rkang pa bdun pa 'gyur med klu/ /thung ba dbang po ring po me/ /er+dhanu daṃ ṣ+ṭi ṇe/ rkang pa brgyad pa yi ge ro/ /thung ba bzhi dang ring po gnyis/ /de ltar yi ge drug cu gcig /thung ba sum cu rtsa bdun dang / /ring po nyi shu rtsa bzhir ni/ /nges pa kyai rdo rjes gsungs/ /lha yi skad la gsal ba yin/ /mā ra ya nas swāhā'i bar/ /yi ge drug cu rtsa bzhir nges/ /mā ra ya gnyis yi ge drug /ring ba lag pa thung ba mtshe/ /kā ra ya gnyis de bzhin te/ /gardzadza ya dang tardzadza ya/ /gnyis gnyis yi ge drug drug thung / /sho ṣa ya gnyis yi ge dus/ /ring ba mig dang thung ba chu/ /sap+ta sā ga rān zhes pa/ /yig lnga thung gsum ring ba gnyis/ /ban+dha ban+dha nā gāṣ+ṭa kān/ /yi ge rnam pa brgyad yin te/ /ring ba gsum dang thung ba lnga/ /gṛh+na gṛh+ṇa sha krūn zhes/ /yig drug gcig ring thung ba lnga/ /ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau ham̐ ha:phaṭ swahā/ yi ge bco lnga thung ngu drug /ring po rnam pa dgu ru nges/ /de ltar yi ge drug cu bzhi/ /ring ba nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /thung ba bzhi bcu gsum du nges/ /des na rtsa ba'i sngags 'di la/ /ring po'i yi ge bzhi bcu lnga/ /thung ngu brgyad cu thams pa rnams/ /sdom grangs brgya dang nyi shu lnga/ /yang dag nges par mkhas rtogs bya/ /'greng bu can dang na ro can/ /mtshams sbyor yi ge yin pa'i phyir/ /thung ngu srid pa ma yin te/ /mtshams sbyor yi ge thung ba med/ /ces pa tsan+t+ra go mi yis/ /yi ge'i mdo las gsungs pa'i phyir/ /ring po phyi mo gnyis par yang /

/sdeb sbyor la sogs gzhung du gsal/ /de phyir 'di dag ring po 'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dag thog mar bod kyi skad du ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ oṃ ni rab bsngags dang / bkra shis pa dang / srungs shig dang / bsod nams len dang / dam bca' ba la sogs pa du ma la 'jug ste/ pra ṇa ba zhes pa oṃ gyi mngon brjod yin pas/ sgrol mar/ swāhā oṃ dang yang dag ldan ma/ /zhes pa'i rgya dper/ swahā pra ṇa ba saṃ yuk+te/ zhes so/ /bkra shis pa la 'jug par phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos las 'byung ste/ sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grel pa zla ba la dga' bas mdzad par drangs pa/ yi ge oṃ dang a tha'i sgra/ /gnyis pa 'di dag sngon tshangs pa'i/ /mkhur tshos brtol te mngon par byung / /des na 'di dag bkra shis yin/ /zhes so/ /srungs shig ces shis pa brjod pa la yang 'jug ste/ a ba dang rak+sha bsrung pa la'o zhes sgra'i khams las so/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i zhabs kyi sgron gsal las/ om̐ ni bsod nams len pa 'o/ /zhes so/ /dam bca' sogs rdo rje rtse mo las gsungs te/ ji skad du/ yi ge oṃ ni ci zhig bshad/ /mchog dang nor ster dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes so/ /slob dpon lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis/ rdo rje gur gyi dka' 'grel las/ om̐ ni/ ar+tha don gyis stong pa'i yid/ shū n+ya ma na/ zhes pa'i nges tshig las yi ge gzhan rnams phyis te/ a/ ū/ ma/ zhes pa mtshams sbyar ba las grub pas don gyis stong pa'i yid ces par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i don can du gsungs so/ /aṣ+ṭa ni brgyad/ a na nā/ zhal bzhi pa'i mtha' can du byas te mtshams sbyar bas/ aṣ+ṭa na nā ya/ zhal brgyad pa las/ zhes pa ste/ pa yig ni 'bru mang po pa'i bsdu ba'i nus pa ste/ 'og ma rnams la'ang ngo / /rnam dbye bzhi pa ni/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / bstod pa dang /

mchod pa sogs la sgra'i gzhung gis sbyor bar bshad do/ ka lā pa las/ na maḥswasti swāhā prā dhā a lam̐ wa ṣaṭa sbyor ba la bzhi pa'o/ /zhes dang / tsan+d+ra pa las/ yang dag par rab tu sbyor la bzhi pa'o zhes sogs kyis/ /piṅga la/ kha dog dmar ser/ ūr+dhā steng ngam gyen/ ke sha/ skra/ warat+man/ 'khyil pa'am brdzes pa/ bzhi pa'i gsal byed phyis te sbyar bas/ piṅga lor+dhā ke sha warat+ma ne/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa la/ zhes pa'o/ /rgya dpe la lar/ piṅgor+dhā/ /zhes 'byung pa ni/ la'i sgra nyams par byas pa zur chag go yin pas cung zad ma dag go ūr+dhā'i wasta ni rgya dpe thams cad la yod pas ma chad pa nyid du gces so/ /tsa tur ni bzhi/ bing+sha ti nyi shu/ ne tra spyan/ bzhi pa sbyar bas/ tsa turbing+sha ti ne tra ya/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la/ zhes pa'o/ ṣo ḍa sha bcu drug bhu dza 'dir bhuñdza zhes klog pa ni ma dag pa ste/ rgya dpe la med pa dang / sgra'i bsgrub tshul las med pa dang / don gzhan za ba zhes la 'jug pa rnams kyi phyir ro/ /phyag de sbyar bas ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ phyag bcu drug pa la/ zhes pa ste/ ka lā pa las/ gal te tshig gnyis dag gyur tam/ /gal te mang po gyur pa'am rung / /de rnams tshig gzhan don la ni/ /'bru mang phyogs bral rnams de bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pas 'di bsdu bya'i tshig las don gzhan phyag bcu drug dang ldan pa ston pas/ 'bru mang po pa'i bsdu ba yin la/ grangs sngon ma can yin pas ba gnyis pa'i bsdu ba yin no/ /kṛṣ+ṇa nag po/ dzī mū ta char sprin/ wa pus/ sku/ nge sbyar bas kṛṣ+ṇa dzi mū ta ba pu ṣe/ char sprin nag po lta bu'i sku can la/ zhes so/ /ka pā la/ thod pa/ mā lā/ phreng ba/ a ne ka du ma/ dhā ra ni/ 'dzin pa/ de sbyar nas mtshams sbyar bas/ ka pā la mā lā ne ka dhā ri ṇi/ thod pa'i phreng ba du ma 'dzin pa la/ zhes pa'o/ /a r+dha/ khong nas sam/ nang nas/ krū ra/ 'khrug pa/

tsit+ta/ sems sam/ thugs/ bzhi pa'i rnam dbye sbyar bas/ a r+dhat+m+ya krū ra tsit+ta ya/ khong nas 'khrug pa'i thugs can la/ zhes pa'am/ nang gi ma rung pa'i thugs can la/ zhes so/ /'dir rgya dpe 'ga' zhig la/ ā dh+ma ta zhes pa yod de/ de yang snga ma bzhin yin la/ mi 'dra ba ni sgra'i bsgrub tshul las 'byung bas 'gal ba med do/ /āt+ma ta zhes par bris snang ba ni/ bdag gi skad dod la āt+ma yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas te/ 'di yang de las ma 'das snyam nas rang bzor bcos par zad do/ /des na/ a dh+yat+m+ya dang / ā dh+mā ta gnyis ka rgya dpe la yang snang / sgra'i gzhung las kyang bsgrub tshul bshad pas rnam grangs su rig par bya'o/ /ar+dha phyed/ in+du zla ba/ daṃ ṣ+ṭin/ mche ba can/ bzhi pa sbyar bas/ ar+dhen+du daṃ ṣ+ṭi ṇa/ zla ba phyed pa lta bu'i mche ba can la/ zhes so/ /'dir rgya dpe kha cig dang / sgrub thabs kha cig las oṃ 'byung yang / rgyud kyi rgya dpe dag pa rnams rgya dpe bdun thams cad na oṃ med ces ya 'brog pa zhang ston bsod grags kyi brtag gnyis ṭi kā las 'byung / kho bos rgyud kyi rgya dpe lnga drug tsam mthong ba na yang / 'di'i thad na oṃ mi snang / 'grel pa ku mu ti dang sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa las kyang / oṃ med pa 'byung zhing / bde mchog gi rtsa sngags/ rkang pa brgyad pa dang / 'di gnyis sngags kyi babs 'dra bas/ bde mchog gi yang rkang brgyad rdzogs nas ka ra ka ra zhes sogs kyi gong na oṃ med pa bzhin/ 'dir yang mā ra ya sogs kyi gong na oṃ med pa rigs pa mtshungs/ rgyu mtshan 'di rnams kyi 'dir oṃ med la/ med bzhin du bcug na/ oṃ med pa yi sngags dag la/ /g.yon can gyi ni oṃ bcug pas/ /sngags kyi nus pa nyams zhes thos/ /zhes so do/ /rje btsun gyi dag ldan du yang / mā ra ya nas swāhā'i bar la yang yi ge drug cu rtsa bzhi yod ces/ oṃ yod par ma gsungs la/

chos rje pas gzhi bshad las kyang oṃ yod par ma gsungs pas/ 'dir oṃ med pa dag par byas so/ /mā ra ya gnyis bsad par gyis gnyis so/ /kā ra ya gnyis byed du chug gam gyis gnyis so/ /gardzadza ya gnyis sgrogs gnyis so/ /tardzadza ya gnyis sdigs gnyis so/ gzhi bshad las rtogs shig ces pa'ang don ni sdigs shig ces pa'o/ /sho ṣa ya gnyis skoms shig gnyis so/ /sap+ta bdun/ sā ga ra rgya mtsho/ gnyis pa'i mang tshig shas sbyar bas/ sap+ta sā ga rān/ rgya mtsho bdun po rnams zhes so/ /ban+dha gnyis ni chings gnyis so/ /nā ga ni/ spyir glang po dang / zha nye dang / gtso bo dang / klu rnams la 'jug pa las/ 'dir klu/ aṣ+ṭa brgyad/ ka'i rkyen mthar gnyis pa'i mang tshig sbyar bas/ nā gāṣ+ṭa kān/ klu brgyad po rnams zhes so/ /gṛh+ṇa gnyis ni/ zungs gnyis/ sha tru dgra bo/ gnyis pa'i rnam dbye sbyar bas sha trūn/ dgra bo rnams zhes so/ /ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau ham̐ ha: rnams ni thabs gsal byed kyi yi ge ha yig srog med bcu gnyis la/ shes rab dbyangs kyi yi ge a ā i ī u ū e ai o au am̐ a: bcu gnyis srog tu bcug pas/ thabs shes dbyer med kyai rdo rje'i bde stong gi bzhad pa'i nyams bcu gnyis mtshon par byed pas/ 'di gsang sngags kyi dngos gzhi lta bu yin te/ dang po/ ha hā hi hī bzhi'i gzhi'am rgyu rtsa 'khor lo bzhi/ bar pa hu hū he hai bzhis lam dga' ba bzhi/ tha ma ho hau haṃ haḥ 'bras bu sku bzhi mtshon ces bhaṣ+ṭa ra ka dad sgrol grags pa'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa'i nyid rdo rje 'chang gi thugs so/ /phaṭa zhes pa/ khos shig ces pa ste/ sgra'i khams kyi glegs bam las/ /phaṭa rnam par 'gems pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i tshig las so/ /'dir sgra las drangs na/ 'bras bu la 'dod pa'am/ smon pa med ces par 'gyur te/ pha las drangs na/ pha la/ 'bras bu ste/ gnyis pa sbyar bas pha laṃ/ 'bras bu la'o/

/ṭa las drangs ni ṭik+ka/ 'chings ba dang 'dod pa la 'jug go de dgag pa'i phyir sngon du nā ti/ pha laṃ nā ti ṭik+ka/ 'bras bu 'dod pa med ces pa ste/ rang don du chos kyi sku don du gnyer ba yang med pa mtshon pa las/ nges pa'i tshig gi mtshan nyid las yi ge nyams pa yod ces pas/ yi ge gzhan rnams phyis pas/ phaṭa zhes pa'o/ /swāhā ni/ skad bye brag tu bshad par/ gzhi tshugs zhes par bsgyur ba grags che mod/ zla ba grags pa'i zhal snga nas/ sgron gsal las dbugs 'byin pa'o zhes gsungs/ 'dir legs pa sbyin pa la 'jug ste/ swā ni/ nyer bsgyur pu dang / āng sbyar bas legs pa'am bzang po kun tu/ hā ni/ hū sbyin pa la bsgrub pas sbyin pa'o/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i cho gar/ swāhā'i phyag rgya la legs so ster ba'i phyag rgya bcas te zhes 'byung ba'ang 'dis shes so/ /rang don du chos sku la'ang don gnyer med pa phaṭa bstan nas/ gzhan don du gzugs sku'i gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i don gcig char 'grub pa ni bde legs kun tu sbyin pa swāhā'i don to/ /de ltar sgra bsgyur tshul rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa bshad nas/ de dag gi don ji lta bu zhe na/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma dpal bir+wa pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba rje sa chen gyis gsungs pa/ lung dang rigs pa phyin ci ma log pas mdzes pa chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa las btus te cung zad dgod par bya'o/ /'di la gsum/ gzhi la sbyar ba/ lam la sbyar ba/ 'bras bu la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ zhal brgyad pa nas/ mche ba can gyi bar gyi rgyu 'khor ba'i rnam par rtog pa bstan/ sod cig nas/ dgra bo rnams kyi bar gyi 'bras bu rigs drug bstan/ ha sogs bcu gnyis kyis rgyu 'bras 'brel byed rten 'brel bcu gnyis bstan to/ /ji ltar na/ zhal brgyad ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad zhal dang 'dra ba mtshon/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pas/

dge ba'i 'bras bu mtho ris/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni dbang po nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ gsal ba dang stong pa'i rgya gnyis dang bcas pa/ phyag bcu drug ni 'pho ba bcu drug gam/ skye mched bcu gnyis/ skye rga na 'chi dang bcas pa/ sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag pa ni/ chos nyid ngo bo mi 'gyur yang / gnas skabs glo bur gyi dri ma dang ldan pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba du ma 'dzin zhes pa yang / thod pa'i sgra ni ka pā la zhes pa yin la/ ka las drangs te/ kā ya zhes pa lus/ pā la skyong ba ste/ 'khor bar nyer len gyi phung po lnga'i lus skyong zhing de'i stobs kyi phreng ba ltar bar ma chad par sdug bsngal 'khor yug 'byung ba mtshon pa'o/ /khong nas 'khrug pa'i thugs can zhes pa/ sems can rnams nyon mongs pa lngas 'khrug cing gdung ba'o/ /mche ba zla phyed lta bu can/ nyon mongs pa ma lus skye ba'i rgyu bdag 'dzin mtshon pa ste/ zla ba tshes pa la mthong bas chags pa bskyed pa ltar bdag la chags pas bdag 'dzin bskyed pas/ zla ba dper mdzad pa'o/ /bdag tu 'dzin pas nyon mongs kyi zas bza' bas mche ba'o/ /gnyis pa de'i 'bras bu rigs drug ni/ sod cig gnyis kyis/ gsod cing gtub pa dmyal ba mtshon/ gyis cig gnyis kyis 'dod yon la longs spyod pa lha/ sgrogs shig gnyis ni 'jig rten chos brgyad grags ma grags gtso bor byed pas mi/ sdigs gnyis mtshon chas sdigs pas lha ma yin/ skems gnyis bkres skom gyis gzir ba yi dwags/ chings gnyis mi shes pas bcings pa dud 'gro rgya mtsho bdun ni rigs drug srid pa bar ma dang bcas pa bdun rgya mtsho ltar zab cing mu med pa'o/ /klu ni bdag tu 'dzin klu gdug pa can lta bu'am/ klu ltar mi zad pa mi khom pa brgyad do/ /dgra bo zungs ni bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra bo bzung ste med par byas na/ thar pa'i gnyen dang 'phrad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa lam la sbyar ba la/ smin byed dbang la sbyar ba dang /

grol byed lam la sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zhal brgyad ni/ slob ma rjes bzung / bsnyen pa/ sa chog sogs zhal dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i gzhi brgyad/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa ni/ dbang gi ye shes rgyas pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni spyan dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i gtso bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ 'jug pa'i chos bcu/ thun mong gi dbang drug thun mong min pa bzhi/ mtha' brten rnam pa bzhi rnams so/ /phyag bcu drug ni cho ga'i yan lag bcu drug ste/ bsnyen pa sa chog lnga dang / sta gon bzhi dang bri ba gsum dang rgyan dgram bsgrub dang mchod/ sku char sprin ltar gnag pa ni/ dbang gi ye shes rnam rtog dang mtshan mas mi 'gyur ba'o/ /thod pa'i phreng ba du ma 'dzin pa zhes pa/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyong ba dang / dbang gi rim pa 'brel chags pa'o/ /nang gi ma rung pa'i thugs can ni/ rnam par rtog pa dang mtshan ma thams cad 'joms pas so/ /mche ba zla ba phyed pa can/ /zhes pa nyon mongs pa ma lus bza' zhing skrag par byed pas so/ /dbang gi ye shes de dag gi khyad par bstan pa ni/ sod gnyis ni rnam rtog gsod pa'o/ /gyis shig gnyis ni/ ye shes nyams su myong ba/ sgrogs shig gnyis ni/ ye shes gzhan la ston pa'o/ /sdigs gnyis ni/ nyon mongs 'joms pa'o/ skoms gnyis ni/ 'khor ba'i chu bo'o/ /rgya mtsho bdun ni/ thun mong gi dbang drug rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang bcas pa'i chus/ rtsa nyon drug lus kyi dri ma dang bcas pa sbyong ba'o/ /klu brgyad ni/ klu rnams kyis char phab nas mi gtsang ba 'khrud cing lo tog rgyas par byed pa ltar/ gsang dbang gi ye shes rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi klu las byung pa'i byang chub sems kyis/ slob ma'i ngag gi dri ma sbyong zhing ye shes rgyas par byed pa'o/ gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /dgra bo rnams zungs shes pa la/ dgra bo ni/ ma rig pa las byung ba'i srid pa'i 'dod chags te/

'gro ba thams cad 'joms pas so/ /de 'dzin pa ni nyon mongs pa byang chub kyi yan lag tu byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /ha sogs bcu gnyis ni/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis te/ 'gro 'ong rtag chad dang bral ba/ ches phra ba/ rdul dang bral ba/ thar pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa zhi ba so so rang gi rig pa'i ye shes bzhi pa'i dbang gsal bar ston pa'o/ /gnyis pa grol byed lam la sbyar ba la/ bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim gnyis/ bskyed rim la spyi dang / bye brag lha dang dur khrod la sbyar ba/ spyi la'ang / mchog bsgrub pa dang / las rgyas pa la sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po la aṣ+ṭa nas/ daṃṣ+ṭa ṇa'i bar gyis/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / mā ra nas swāhā'i bar gyi ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor bstan to/ /de yang zhal brgyad ni mngon par rtogs pa sgo brgyad de/ sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang / dngos gzhi yan lag drug go /skra dmar ser brdzes pa ni bsgoms pa las byung ba'i rtogs pa rgyas pa'o/ /spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ spyan dang 'dra ba'i mngon par rtogs pa'i gtso bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag la/ gzhi rgyu rkyen gyi yan lag gsum/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa/ gdan bsgom pa dang lnga'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag la/ mngon par byang chub pa lnga/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs/ snyoms par zhugs pa/ 'khor dbyung ba/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ zhu glus bskul ba/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa/ snod bcud sbyang ba/ skye mched byin gyis brlabs pa/ ye shes pa gzhug pa ste bcu bzhi'o/ /mi bskyod pa'i yan lag la/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa gnyis/ 'od dpag med dang / don yod grub pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag rnams re re ste/ de ltar nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i don to/ /phyag bcu drug ni/ phyag dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i yan lag bcu drug ste/

snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer spro ba/ des tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa/ de la mchod pa/ yan lag bdun dang / tshad med bzhi/ ye shes kyi tshogs dang / srung ba'i 'khor lo ste bcu drug go /sku mdog char sprin ltar nag ni/ bskyed pa'i ye shes rtogs pas mi 'gyur ba'o/ /thod phreng du ma 'dzin zhes pa la/ thod pa'i sgra la yi ge bsnan pas kā ya pā la/ lus skyong ba ste/ tha mal pa'i lus lha'i rnal 'byor gyis bskyangs pas 'bras bu gzugs sku 'grub pas bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor ldan zhes pa'o/ /khong nas 'khrug pa'i thugs zhes pa/ bskyed rim gyi ye shes des mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong zhing bar chad sel bar byed ces sbyar ro/ /zla ba phyed pa'i mche ba can zhes pa ye shes des tha mal rnam rtog gi rab rib 'joms pas zla ba lta bu dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs bza' bar byed pas mche ba/ 'di man chad kyis mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor bstan te/ sod cig gnyis ni/ rnam rtog gi 'phro ba bsdu pas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ gyis shig gnyis ni bya ba la 'jug pas ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ sgrogs shig gnyis ni/ sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pas bzlas pa/ rtogs shig gnyis ni mchod pa dang gtor ma dang / skoms shig gnyis ni kha zas 'ju bas zas kyi rnal 'byor/ rgya mtsho bdun ni khrus kyi rnal 'byor/ klu brgyad ni 'dir phyag rgya rigs brgyad yin la/ dgra bo zungs ni nyon mongs pa byang chub kyi yan lag tu byed pa ste/ rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor/ ha sogs bcu gnyis ni skye mched bcu gnyis gti mug rdo rje ma sogs dang gau rī sogs su bsgyur te yul la longs spyod pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ston no/ /gnyis pa lha dang dur khrod la sbyar ba la/ lha la sbyar ba ni/ rgyud nyid las/ aṣ+ṭa na na ya/ zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /ces dang / tsa turbing+sha ti daṃ ṣ+ṭi ya/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/

/zhes dang / ṣo ḍa na bhu dzā ya/ phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /ces dang / kraṣ+ṇa dzī mu ta wa pu ṣe/ byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag ces dang / kā pā la mā lā ne ka dha ri ṇa/ gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /zhes sogs dang ci rigs pa sbyar te gzhan du rnyed par sla'o/ /dur khrod la sbyar na/ mā ra ya gnyis gtum pa'i las byed pa'i phyogs skyong bstan/ kā ra ya gnyis kyis de'i mnga' gzhug byed pa'i zhing skyong bstan/ sgrogs shig gnyis kyis sprin bstan/ rtogs shig gnyis kyis shing brgyad/ skoms shig gnyis kyis me brgyad/ rgya mtsho bdun gyis chu bo/ chings gnyis kyis ro la sogs pa/ klu brgyad ni dngos so/ /dgra bo ni 'dre dang srin po sogs so/ /ha sogs bcu gnyis kyis ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis thugs su chud pa'i grub pa thob pa rnams bstan to/ /gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ sod cig gnyis mngon spyod/ gyis shig gnyis dbang / sdigs shig gnyis dgug pa/ sgrogs shig gnyis rgyas pa/ skoms shig gnyis zhi ba/ rgya mtsho bdun zhes pas char dbab pa/ klu brgyad 'chings pas dug gzhil ba/ dgra bo zungs kyis rim gyis 'debs pa/ ha sogs bcu gnyis kyis grub chen brgyad dang / mkha' spyod dang / rig pa 'dzin pa dang / 'khor lo bsgyur ba dang / gnod sbyin mo bsgrub pa dang bcu gnyis so/ /de dag gis bskyed pa'i rim pa la sbyar ba bstan to/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa la'ang rang byin rlabs dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zhal brgyad ni rlung gi sbyor ba bdun/ rang gi ngo bo dang brgyad do/ /mas brtan gyi dga' ba rgyas pas dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa'o/ /spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa nyer bzhi'am yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /phyag bcu drug ni rlung 'pho ba bcu drug go /sku mdog nag pos ni/ gtum mo'i mes spyi bo'i haṃ bsregs pa bstan/

thod pa'i phreng ba du ma 'dzin pas/ bde ba skyong ba'i byang sems 'dzin pa mtshon/ khong nas 'khrug pa'i thugs zhes pas/ ye shes kyi rnam rtog spongs ba mtshon/ zla ba phyed pa'i mche ba can zhes pas/ haṃ las byang sems g.yon char 'bab pa bstan/ ye shes des rnam rtog 'joms pas sod cig gnyis/ bde ba bskyed pas gyis shig gnyis/ de gzhan la ston pas sgrogs shig gnyis/ rnam rtog phye mar byed pas sdigs gnyis/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems par byed pas rgya mtsho bdun skoms gnyis/ ye shes des rnam shes tshogs brgyad tha mal gyi yul la 'jug pas 'chings pas/ klu brgyad chings gnyis/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra bo zhi bar byed pas dgra bo zungs gnyis/ skye mched bcu gnyis dag pa'i ye shes su gnas gyur pas ha sogs bcu gnyis so/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang sbyar ba la/ gang la brten nas skye ba'i rten phyag rgya/ de las skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes/ ye shes des rnam rtog spong ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ zhal brgyad phyag rgya rigs brgyad/ dbu skra brdzes pa mas brtan dga' ba rgyas pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni rig ma'i lo grangs mtshon pa'am dbye ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyag bcu drug gis dga' ba'i dga' ba la sogs pa bcu drug go /sku mdog char sprin nag po lta bu ni ye shes de rnam par rtog pas mi 'gyur ba'o/ /thod pa'i phreng ba du ma 'dzin pa byang chub sems kyi phreng ba yas babs dang / mas brtan dga' ba'i tshul gyi bde ba skyong ba'o/ /khong nas 'khrug pa'i thugs ni/ dal rgyu'i rlung gi kun+da byang sems rdo rje'i lus la khyab pa'i stobs shugs kyis mtshan rtog spong ba'o/ /zla ba phyed pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa ni/ dud 'gro'i lta stangs la sogs pa'i 'gyur ba bzhis/ byang chub kyi sems kyi 'gyur ba 'gegs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sod cig ces sogs sngar bdag byin rlabs la sbyar ba bzhin 'dir yang ngo /

/rdzogs pa'i rim pa la sbyar ba'o/ /lam la sbyar ba bshad zin to/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la sbyar ba la sku gsum ste/ dang po longs sku ni/ zhal brgyad nas mche ba can gyi bar rkang pa brgyad kyis bstan te/ sbyor ba'i tshul ni sngar bshad pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa sprul pa'i sku ni/ gdul bya gang na gnas pa der/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa gang la gang 'dul ston pa ste/ de yang / gdug cing gtum pa'i sems can la/ /zhi ba nye bar mi sbyor te/ /zhes dang / gang dang gang gi rnam pa yis/ /skyes pa rnams ni yid sbyor ba/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin du/ gdug pa can gdug pa'i rnam pas 'dul bas na/ sod cig gnyis so/ /thabs sna tshogs kyis sems can rjes su 'dzin pas gyis shig gnyis so/ /gsung gis ji ltar mtshams pa'i chos ston pas sgrogs shig gnyis so/ /'gal rkyen zhi bar byed pas sdigs shig gnyis so/ /'gro ba bdun pa'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pas rgya mtsho bdun rnams skoms gnyis so/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs pa ma lus zhi bar byed pas klu brgyad po rnams chings gnyis so/ /rnam par rtog pa dgra bo dang 'dra ba med par byed pas/ dgra bo rnams zungs gnyis so/ /gsum pa chos kyi sku ni/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i de bzhin nyid skye 'gag rtag chad la sogs pa'i spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba zab zhi 'od gsal gyi dbyings mtshon pa ha hā la sogs bcu gnyis gsungs so/ /zhes pa 'bras bu la sbyar ba'o/ /de dag thams cad chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal snga nas rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rnam bshad snying po don gsal zhes bya ba las 'byung pa cung zad btus nas bris la/ rgyas par de nyid du blta'o/ /'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan brtag pa gnyis pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ /rdo rje snying pos bsdus pa'i 'phags yul gyi/ bsdu pa po dang zhu ba po/

bod kyi dpe ni yi ge ma dag pa ches mang bas de bor nas/ /rnam dag glegs bam las ni 'byung ba bzhin/ te yul dbus kyi paṇ+ḍi tas bris pa/ /sngags kyi tshig dag ji lta ba bzhin legs bkod nas don 'khrul med du gtan la dbab pa ni/ rdo rje'i mkha' 'gros rje btsun bdag med ma/ rjes bzung bas/ /sa drug gi rtog pa brnyes nas nus pa'i khyad par bstan pa ni gaṅgā gyen la bzlog lha rten bkas shing dpal ldan pad+mo'i gnyen/ nyi ma'i mngon brjod/ /thogs med 'gro zhing rdzu 'phrul cher grags 'dis/ /gang gis myos byed gteng par bcug gyur pa/ /mthu stobs kyi bstan pa bzung ba stobs kyi mgon po dpal ldan rang gis ngan par zhal gyis bzhes pas bi ru pa/ /gang des brgyud pa min par dngos su rjes bzung pa/ /sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa dpal ldan thugs rje'i gter/ /de yis rje btsun sku mched la/ bshad pa'i man ngag phyogs gcig tu/ dbyangs can bdag po ste 'jam dbyangs/ /skye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar paṇ+ḍi ta'i/ tshul bzung chos rje ba/ tshig gi gter mnga' legs gsungs pa'i/ /legs bshad rgya mtsho'i aṣ+ṭa'i gzhi bshad che las don gyi gnad btus te bshad/ pas yid ches pa'i 'os so/ /spyir yang shākya seng ge'i gsung rab mdo sde las brgya pa sogs las/ /ngag gi las 'di rnam smin dge sdig 'dra che bar gsungs/ /khyad par rigs sngags log par bzlas gyur na/ /dug sngags med par dug sbrul reg dang mtshungs/ /ngal ba 'bras med ces sogs yang yang gsungs/ /deng sang gangs can thar 'dod phal cher yang / lung rigs dang ltar snang gis ni thams cad rnam par rtsen yod/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i yang dag bral mun sprul mi shes bzhin du rang bzo la/

/mchog tu 'dzin tshe phyogs 'di dgos pa med/ pa ltar gyur mod/ /'on kyang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu 'gro bar/ 'dod rnams la rtsa sngags rnam par dag pa'i tshul 'di bdud rtsi bzhin/ /zhes bsam rang dang skal ba mnyam pa yi/ /dngos brgyud rigs dang chos las skyes pa'i slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang / /khyad par rang nyid dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la/ /goms pa lhur len bya ba ste bag chags 'jog pa'i phyir 'di bgyis pa'i/ dge ba gang des bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ dus 'dir tshe ring nad lus la sems la sdug bsngal med par bsam don 'grub/ /spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa cher rgyas don rang dang gzhan gyi gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /tshe ring ba'i mthar son te nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag bdag cag dpon slob la /mthong thos dran reg du gyur pa'i 'gro ba kun kyang lhan cig tu/ /dag pa'i zhing gi mchog bde ba can du thogs med du skyes nas khams gsum gyi 'gro kun dag pa'i zhing der 'dren nus par shog ces dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rnam par bshad pa zab don rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po grub pa mchog gi ded dpon 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i aṣ+ṭa'i gzhi bshad chen mo dang /

de nyid kyi gsal byed zhwa lu lo tsā ba chen po chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i rtsa sngags kyi gsal byed sgron me 'bar ba gnyis kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa 'di ni sa pho 'brug gi lo dbo zla ba'i dmar cha'i tshes la gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms pa'i nyin dpal sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i shar lho rig 'dzin pho brang gi yang rtse mkha' spyod bde ba can du sbyar ba 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 16 a myes zhabs/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rnam par bshad pa zab don rgyas pa'i nyin bye/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 15
